Heard learned counsel for the Applicant and learned  APP for the State.
2. On 9th February 2023, the applicant was protected by  an interim order.

The relevant portion of the order reads  thus:-
 "2.

This is an application for pre-arrest bail by the  applicant in connection with C.R. No.1034 of 2021 dated  20/08/2021, registered with Tulinj Police Station, under sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and sections 3 and 4 of the Maharashtra Protection of Interest o  Depositors (in Financial Establishments) Act, 1999.

sentences.text: Accordingly, the complainant  invested a sum of Rs. 18,52,000/- in the company.
The First  1  Tauseef 903.aba.235-23.doc  Information Report was registered on 20/08/2021.

The  supplementary statement of the complainant came to be  recorded on 21/08/2021 wherein she stated that a sum of  Rs. 10,28,000/- was handed over in cash to the present  applicant for investing in the company called Eaglight.
4. Materials on record reveal that said amount was  handed over by the applicant to the accused no. 1.
So far as  the applicant is concerned, it is alleged that he has received  a commission of Rs. 37,000/-.
Considering the nature of the  allegations, it is necessary that the applicant cooperate with  the investigation.
From the First Information Report though  the applicant has collected cash, he is not the one who  induced the complainant to invest money.
The applicant can  be granted interim protection.

5. In the meantime, in the event of arrest of the  applicant in respect of C.R. No.1034 of 2021, registered with  Tulinj Police Station, the applicant Hannan Khan, shall be  released on bail on his furnishing P.R. bond in the sum of  Rs.15,000/- with one or more sureties in the like amount."
3. The applicant reported and co-operated with the investigation.
4. Considering the nature of allegations, the main accusations are against the accused no.1 who induced the complainant to invest the amount in the company.
It is not the applicant who has induced the complainant.
It is alleged that the applicant was working as a commission agent and that he received a commission of Rs.35,000/-.
The interim protection, therefore, needs to be confrmed as the custodial interrogation of the applicant is not required.
There is no criminal antecedent against the applicant.
Hence, the following order.
